svg.title: GlassDock auto-hide
svg.desc: A looping animation in four beats. The dock is hidden and the app idles at 0% CPU, with only a thin hot zone at the bottom edge of the screen. The pointer reaches the bottom edge and the hot zone glows. The glass dock slides up with a slight overshoot while the backdrop is captured for refraction. The pointer leaves upward, a short countdown (shown in slow motion) runs for the 0.45 second hide delay, the dock slides down again and an idle 0% CPU badge appears.
svg.text: Pointer leaves, 0.45 s later it hides
